tests.name: CoursesController POST /courses delegates to CoursesService.createCourse with uid + dto
CoursesController GET /courses lists current instructor courses
CoursesController GET /courses/:cid returns hydrated tree
CoursesController PATCH /courses/:cid forwards the patch
CoursesController DELETE /courses/:cid deletes the course
CoursesController POST /courses/:cid/modules creates a module
CoursesController PATCH /courses/:cid/modules/:mid updates a module
CoursesController DELETE /courses/:cid/modules/:mid deletes a module
CoursesController PUT /courses/:cid/modules/order reorders modules
CoursesController POST /courses/:cid/modules/:mid/lessons creates a lesson
CoursesController PATCH /courses/:cid/modules/:mid/lessons/:lid updates a lesson
CoursesController DELETE /courses/:cid/modules/:mid/lessons/:lid deletes a lesson
CoursesController PUT /courses/:cid/modules/:mid/lessons/order reorders lessons
CoursesController — slice D routes GET /publish-eligibility returns the service result
CoursesController — slice D routes POST /publish returns updated course
CoursesController — slice D routes POST /unpublish returns updated course
CoursesController — slice D routes POST /archive returns updated course
CoursesController — slice D routes POST /restore returns updated course
CoursesService — course operations createCourse writes a new DRAFT course with generated id and instructor ownership
CoursesService — course operations createCourse includes optional fields when supplied
CoursesService — course operations listCoursesForInstructor delegates to the repository
CoursesService — course operations getCourseTree returns hydrated course + modules + lessons
CoursesService — course operations getCourseTree throws CourseNotFoundException when the course is missing
CoursesService — course operations updateCourse forwards the patch to the repository unchanged
CoursesService — course operations updateCourse forwards a multi-field patch
CoursesService — course operations deleteCourse invokes recursive delete
CoursesService — module operations createModule appends a new module with a generated id
CoursesService — module operations updateModule forwards a rename patch
CoursesService — module operations updateModule throws ModuleNotFoundException when the module does not exist
CoursesService — module operations deleteModule checks existence then recursive-deletes
CoursesService — module operations deleteModule throws ModuleNotFoundException when the module does not exist
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules writes the new order when ids match current children exactly
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules places modules in the requested order by id, preserving each doc's other fields
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules throws StaleReorderException when proposed list is shorter than current
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules throws StaleReorderException when proposed list is longer than current
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules throws StaleReorderException when proposed list contains an id not in current (same length)
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules throws StaleReorderException when ids are missing one
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules throws StaleReorderException when ids include a stranger
CoursesService — module operations reorderModules throws StaleReorderException when ids contain duplicates
CoursesService — lesson operations createLesson requires the module to exist
CoursesService — lesson operations createLesson appends a new lesson with a generated id
CoursesService — lesson operations createLesson omitting description does not pass a description key to the repository
CoursesService — lesson operations updateLesson forwards the patch when the lesson exists
CoursesService — lesson operations updateLesson throws LessonNotFoundException when the lesson is missing
CoursesService — lesson operations deleteLesson throws LessonNotFoundException when the lesson is missing
CoursesService — lesson operations deleteLesson deletes the lesson when it exists
CoursesService — lesson operations deleteLesson cascades to VideoService.deleteForLesson before deleting the lesson doc
CoursesService — lesson operations deleteLesson does not delete the lesson doc when deleteForLesson rejects
CoursesService — lesson operations reorderLessons writes the new order when ids match current children exactly
CoursesService — lesson operations reorderLessons places lessons in the requested order by id, preserving each doc's other fields
CoursesService — lesson operations reorderLessons throws StaleReorderException when ids mismatch
CoursesService — lesson operations reorderLessons requires the parent module to exist
PublishService.computeEligibility returns COURSE_HAS_NO_MODULES for a course with no modules
PublishService.computeEligibility returns eligible:true when every lesson has a READY video
PublishService.computeEligibility folds VideoNotFoundException into LESSON_HAS_NO_VIDEO (orphan)
PublishService.computeEligibility deduplicates videoId reads across lessons
PublishService.computeEligibility throws CourseArchivedException when status === ARCHIVED
PublishService.computeEligibility throws CourseNotFoundException when the course is absent
PublishService.publish publishes a DRAFT course when eligible, setting publishedAt
PublishService.publish throws InvalidTransitionException when source state is not DRAFT
PublishService.publish throws PublishNotEligibleException with reasons when revalidation fails
PublishService.unpublish transitions PUBLISHED → DRAFT, preserves publishedAt
PublishService.unpublish throws InvalidTransitionException when source is not PUBLISHED
PublishService.archive archives a DRAFT course, sets archivedAt
PublishService.archive archives a PUBLISHED course, sets archivedAt
PublishService.archive throws InvalidTransitionException when already ARCHIVED
PublishService.restore transitions ARCHIVED → DRAFT, clears archivedAt
PublishService.restore throws InvalidTransitionException when source is not ARCHIVED
CoursesException family CoursesException carries code, message, status, and optional details
CoursesException family NotCourseOwnerException is 403 with code NOT_COURSE_OWNER
CoursesException family CourseNotFoundException is 404 with code COURSE_NOT_FOUND
CoursesException family ModuleNotFoundException is 404 with code MODULE_NOT_FOUND
CoursesException family LessonNotFoundException is 404 with code LESSON_NOT_FOUND
CoursesException family StaleReorderException is 409 with code STALE_REORDER
slice D exceptions InvalidTransitionException carries currentState + requested as details and is HTTP 409
slice D exceptions PublishNotEligibleException carries reasons[] as details and is HTTP 409
slice D exceptions CourseArchivedException is HTTP 409 with code COURSE_ARCHIVED
CoursesExceptionFilter maps a CoursesException to its declared status and code
CoursesExceptionFilter preserves details when present
CoursesExceptionFilter maps a NestJS BadRequestException (DTO validation) to VALIDATION_FAILED with fieldErrors
CoursesExceptionFilter delegates an InsufficientRoleException (AuthException subclass) to a 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE
CoursesExceptionFilter falls back to INTERNAL for unknown exceptions
composeReasons returns COURSE_HAS_NO_MODULES (alone) for an empty course
composeReasons returns MODULE_HAS_NO_LESSONS for a module with zero lessons
composeReasons returns LESSON_HAS_NO_VIDEO when lesson.videoId is undefined
composeReasons returns LESSON_HAS_NO_VIDEO when videoId is set but video doc is missing (orphan fold)
composeReasons returns LESSON_VIDEO_NOT_READY for state PENDING_UPLOAD
composeReasons returns LESSON_VIDEO_NOT_READY for state UPLOADING
composeReasons returns LESSON_VIDEO_NOT_READY for state UPLOADED
composeReasons returns LESSON_VIDEO_NOT_READY for state TRANSCODING
composeReasons returns LESSON_VIDEO_NOT_READY for state FAILED
composeReasons returns eligible:true with no reasons when every lesson has a READY video
composeReasons orders reasons by moduleOrder ASC, then lessonOrder ASC
composeReasons emits at most one reason per lesson — orphan takes precedence over not-ready
CourseOwnerGuard returns true and stashes the course when the user owns it
CourseOwnerGuard throws CourseNotFoundException when the course does not exist
CourseOwnerGuard throws NotCourseOwnerException when another user owns the course
CourseOwnerGuard throws NotCourseOwnerException when no user is attached (defensive — InstructorRoleGuard should have blocked already)
